description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that two members of the Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacancies, and electoral commission decisions.
